title: 'Online court hearing' with a judge, bail by UPI

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please hold for the virtual hearing of the Supreme Court cyber bench. Your case number is SC/CYB/2291.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is Justice Malhotra. You are accused of financing illegal activity through your bank account. Do you understand the charges?

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Yes, your honour, but I am innocent.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The court orders you to remain on video until the hearing ends. Speaking to anyone during the hearing is contempt of court.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Bail is fixed at three lakh rupees, payable now to the court registry UPI ID. It will be refunded when you are acquitted.
